text: protected function validateMax(string $field, mixed $value, array $params): ?string { $max = (int)($params[0] ?? 0); if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > $max) { return "The {$field} must not exceed {$max} characters."; } if (is_numeric($value) && (float)$value > $max) { return "The {$field} must not exceed {$max}."; } return null; }
